title: The guard reads a builder's workflow Edit in the whole file, not the fragment alone
why: Lane test-author-ci-step-false-alarm (session_013NEJKzayeNCJa4csSCBG7k), via the coordinator 11:16 CST Nov 8: the guard judges a builder's workflow Edit on the fragment alone. Probed: an Edit that adds `continue-on-error: true` below a test step's name line passes when the step's `run:` line sits below the fragment. Wiring workflow_file_pair into the builder path also loosens workflow_drops_tests for a duplicated run, so this needs its own lane.
note: Coordinator 12:36 CST Nov 8: #2186 handed to runner 8 (merge after #2172).
